    strain, rate = matrices(taus)
    drift = rate[:, 2:] @ theta[2:]
    # The chamber gates the intrinsic drift: r(t) = r(0) exp(-t/duration).

    return strain @ theta - drift[:, None] * gate_loss, rate @ theta
